def solve(n, length, p):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    quotient = n // p[length]
    remainder = n % p[length]
    if remainder == 0:
        return quotient * length
    return quotient * length + min(solve(remainder, length - 1, p), length + solve(p[length] - remainder, length - 1, p))

def main():
    p = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        p[i] = p[i - 1] * 10 + 1
    n = int(input().strip())
    print(solve(n, 16, p))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
